decisions.reason: The position requires constructing a new filter-pipe sump with drainage fill. Removing it afterward does not negate the material supply.

items.material_name: DN 400 filter-pipe pump sump, up to 1 m deep, with minimum 15 cm drainage surround
items.description: Temporary sump formed from filter pipe with a 400 mm clear diameter and a free-draining fill surround.

decisions.reason: The position specifies a new vertical safety ladder for installation in the manhole, including its entry extension and fixings.

items.material_name: DIN EN 14396 vertical manhole safety ladder, stainless steel 1.4301/1.4307, 400 mm clear width, 280 mm rung spacing, R13 rungs, for 2.35 m shaft depth, with 1,200 mm EH S entry extension
items.description: Safety ladder with perforated U-profile rungs, adjustable wall brackets, M10 anchors, and a removable entry extension.

decisions.reason: This is a lump-sum site setup service. It requires making equipment and facilities available but does not specify a new product to purchase.
